description: Picks one of two signals for a single output, choosing between them by comparing a voltage against a threshold

params.text: Sets the voltage the CV jack is compared against, -10V to +10V
Sets how long the crossfade between the two inputs takes, 1ms to 10 seconds; fully anticlockwise the change is instant

inputs.text: The voltage that chooses the source: below the threshold IN1 reaches the output, at or above it IN2 does
Moves the threshold, scaled by the trimpot above it and added to the THR knob, with the total held between -10V and +10V
The signal that reaches the output while the CV jack is below the threshold
The signal that reaches the output while the CV jack is at or above the threshold
Lengthens the crossfade by one second per volt, added to the FADE knob, with the total held between 0 and 10 seconds

outputs.text: Whichever of the two inputs the CV jack has selected

inputs.1:
±10V · continuous · one channel only

the knob and this input are summed and the total held to ±10V.
inputs.4:
continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
